name: Cable Incline Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline facing away from a low cable pulley with a rope attached.
Lie back with feet flat and hold the rope ends behind your head with your elbows pointing upward.
Straighten both elbows to extend your hands upward until your arms are nearly straight.
Bend your elbows under control to lower the rope back behind your head.
tips: Keep your upper arms in place as your forearms move.
Keep your elbows from flaring wide and brace your core so your lower back stays steady.
